units: <cite ref="Avot D'Rabbi Natan 18">Ab. d’R. N. ch. XVIII</cite>; <cite ref="Gittin 67a:8">Gitt. 67ᵃ</cite> <he>ר׳ יוסי נִימּוּקוֹ עמו</he> gave to R. Jose the surname, ‘His depth is with him’, i.e. he has deep reasons for whatever he says.
<cite ref="Gittin 67a:3">Ib.</cite> <he>אלמלא ראיתו נ׳ עמו</he> if thou hadst seen him, (thou wouldst have seen) his depth was &c.
<cite ref="Bekhorot 37a:17">Bekh. 37ᵃ</cite> <he>מהו דתימא נ׳ עמו</he> you might have thought, we must adopt R. Jose’s opinion because he is known to have deep reasons.
